card.title: Diagnostics
card.noData: This device hasn't sent engine data yet.

source.gps: added up by the platform from the distance driven
source.ignition: added up by the platform from engine-on time

now.empty: This device hasn't sent vehicle data in the last seven days. Reading it takes a device with an OBD reader or connected to the vehicle's network (CAN).
now.note: Only what this device reads from the vehicle shows up. Each value shows its latest reading.
now.othersNote: They arrive without a name: the platform doesn't know what they measure. They're shown as they come in case they help you identify a sensor.

chart.empty: The device didn't send that value in this period.

faults.empty: This vehicle hasn't reported fault codes. They show up here, with their explanation, when the device reads them from the vehicle's computer.
faults.none: None: the vehicle reports no faults now.

meters.needValue: Enter what the dashboard shows: the odometer, the hours, or both.
meters.lead: If the device reads them from the vehicle's computer, those count. If not, the platform adds them up since <num>{{since}}</num>: that's why it's worth adjusting them once to what the dashboard shows.
meters.adjustTitle: Adjust to what the dashboard shows
meters.saved: Adjusted. They keep adding up from here.

rpmMax.label: Engine speed
rpmMax.note: Alerts if the engine goes above this for a few seconds.

tempMaxC.label: Engine temperature
tempMaxC.note: Alerts if it goes above this for half a minute.

voltageMinV.label: Vehicle battery
voltageMinV.note: Alerts if it drops below this for several minutes. It's for 12 V: on a 24 V vehicle it counts double.

limits.needOwn: Enter the {{label}} limit for this vehicle.
limits.saved: Saved. It applies from the next position.
limits.note: A new fault code always alerts. Alerts show up among the platform's alerts.
limits.accountLead: They apply to every vehicle without its own limit. Leave one empty to turn off that alert for the account.
limits.whoNote: Who gets alerted about faults, overheating, engine speed and low battery is set in Administration → Notifications.
